title: MZ Modifying Mog's Plugins | Layers & Particles on The Game Over Scene

posts.author: BluestreakX
posts.body:
Hey guys, so I'm using
Mog's Plugins
in my game, particularly we're talking about title particles, title layers, and weather EX.
I'm looking for help modifying the plugins (which is allowed, to my understanding) or creating a plugin that calls on them as a resource, so that I can have multiple layers in my game over scene, with particles.
There's a big cherry tree in my game and lots of cherry blossoms, and when you die you're shown the same scene as the title screen. I would like this scene to have the same effects.
Possibly 60 particles total, 3 different types of leaves set to 20 particles a piece. I would like moving parallax layers as in the title layers plugin, so that I can have moving dust and clouds.
I don't know enough coding or javascript to make this possible, but I don't see why this plugin can't exist, the effects I am asking for can already be reliably reproduced in other scenes.
Please help me with this plugin, please make this small dream a reality!
